# Use a Ubuntu base image with bash shell support and stable package manager behavior
FROM --platform=linux/x86_64 ubuntu:22.04

ARG DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
ENV TZ=Etc/UTC
SHELL ["/bin/bash", "-c"]

# Install system essentials and dependencies: git, curl, wget, software-properties-common for adding repos,
# build-essential, python3, python3-venv, python3-pip, nodejs, npm, and other utilities
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    git \
    curl \
    wget \
    build-essential \
    python3.11 \
    python3.11-venv \
    python3.11-distutils \
    python3-pip \
    python3-setuptools \
    ca-certificates \
    locales \
    tzdata \
    gnupg \
    software-properties-common \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Set locale
RUN locale-gen en_US.UTF-8
ENV LANG=en_US.UTF-8
ENV LANGUAGE=en_US:en
ENV LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8

# Install Node.js (LTS version). No specific version given, so install Node.js 18.x LTS via NodeSource
RUN curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_18.x | bash - && \
    apt-get install -y nodejs && \
    npm install -g npm@latest && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Install Poetry >=1.4 using official recommended install script
RUN curl -sSL https://install.python-poetry.org | python3 - --version 1.6.1

# Add Poetry to PATH
ENV PATH="/root/.local/bin:$PATH"

# Create working directory
WORKDIR /testbed/

# Clone the repo and checkout specific commit
ARG REPO=https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow.git
ARG COMMIT_SHA=a4dc5381b2cf31c507cc32f9027f76bf00d61ccc

RUN git clone $REPO /testbed && \
    cd /testbed && \
    git checkout $COMMIT_SHA && \
    git submodule update --init --recursive && \
    chmod -R a+rwx /testbed

# Install Python dependencies using Poetry inside a virtual environment "testbed" as recommended
# Create and activate virtual environment and export variables for shell session
RUN python3.11 -m venv /testbed/.venv && \
    source /testbed/.venv/bin/activate && \
    python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel && \
    poetry config virtualenvs.in-project true && \
    poetry install --no-root --no-interaction --no-ansi && \
    poetry install --with dev --no-interaction --no-ansi && \
    # Install local repo in editable/development mode to ensure local code is used
    pip install -e . && \
    # Also install Node.js dependencies if any from /testbed (optional, since required)
    if [ -f package.json ]; then npm install; fi

# Write an environment activation script for convenience, enabling virtual environment and Poetry in bash
RUN echo "source /testbed/.venv/bin/activate" >> /root/.bashrc && \
    echo "export PATH=/root/.local/bin:\$PATH" >> /root/.bashrc

# Set default shell to bash for all RUN commands and interactive shell
ENV SHELL=/bin/bash

- Running the python command with `-m` or adjusting `PYTHONPATH` so that 'src.backend.db.database' is importable.
- Changing directory or setting environment variables so imports work.

The test log shows a critical error at the step where the script tries to create the database schema and use the database models. Specifically, the Python command `python3 -c "from sqlmodel import SQLModel; from src.backend.db.database import engine; SQLModel.metadata.create_all(engine)"` fails with `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'src.backend.db'`. This suggests that the PYTHONPATH setting is not correctly allowing Python to find the 'src.backend.db' module.

Moreover, this line runs before invoking `poetry run pytest ...`, so the environment activation and path configurations might not be fully effective for this Python invocation.

Additionally, the log reveals that many tests fail with a `sqlite3.OperationalError: no such table: user`. This indicates the database schema was not correctly created or is empty during test execution. The schema creation attempt in the eval script fails (due to the previous import error), likely causing these test failures that depend on database tables.

1. Ensure that the PYTHONPATH is correctly set in the environment where the Python command runs to create the database schema. It can be set as an environment variable export before the command or passed inline.
2. Activate the poetry environment before running this Python command and the subsequent pytest command, so all dependencies and paths are correctly recognized.
3. Confirm that the database schema creation line successfully runs without error before pytest starts executing tests.
4. Consider combining environment activation, PYTHONPATH setting, and schema creation in one continuous shell command or script block to preserve environment context.

# Use Ubuntu 22.04 base image with bash shell support for a stable environment
FROM ubuntu:22.04

ARG DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
ENV TZ=Etc/UTC
SHELL ["/bin/bash", "-c"]

# Install system essentials and dependencies: git, curl, wget, build tools, Python 3.11 and related packages,
# locales, timezone data, gnupg and software-properties-common for adding repos
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    git \
    curl \
    wget \
    build-essential \
    python3.11 \
    python3.11-venv \
    python3.11-distutils \
    python3-pip \
    python3-setuptools \
    ca-certificates \
    locales \
    tzdata \
    gnupg \
    software-properties-common \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Generate the locale explicitly to avoid locale warnings and ensure environment stability
RUN locale-gen en_US.UTF-8

# Set locale environment variables
ENV LANG=en_US.UTF-8
ENV LANGUAGE=en_US:en
ENV LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8

# Install Node.js 20.x LTS via NodeSource to ensure compatibility with latest npm
RUN curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_20.x | bash - && \
    apt-get install -y nodejs && \
    npm install -g npm@latest && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Install Poetry 1.6.1 as specified via official install script
RUN curl -sSL https://install.python-poetry.org | python3 - --version 1.6.1

# Add Poetry to PATH to be available in sessions
ENV PATH="/root/.local/bin:$PATH"

# Set working directory
WORKDIR /testbed/

# Clone repository and checkout the exact commit SHA
ARG REPO=https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow.git
ARG COMMIT_SHA=a4dc5381b2cf31c507cc32f9027f76bf00d61ccc

RUN git clone $REPO /testbed && \
    cd /testbed && \
    git checkout $COMMIT_SHA && \
    git submodule update --init --recursive && \
    chmod -R a+rwx /testbed

# Create Python virtual environment
RUN python3.11 -m venv /testbed/.venv

# Upgrade pip, setuptools, wheel inside virtual environment
RUN /bin/bash -c "source /testbed/.venv/bin/activate && python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel"

# Configure Poetry to create virtualenvs in project directory
RUN /bin/bash -c "source /testbed/.venv/bin/activate && poetry config virtualenvs.in-project true"

# Install project dependencies (without installing the project itself) via Poetry
RUN /bin/bash -c "source /testbed/.venv/bin/activate && poetry install --no-root --no-interaction --no-ansi"

# Install development dependencies via Poetry
RUN /bin/bash -c "source /testbed/.venv/bin/activate && poetry install --with dev --no-interaction --no-ansi"

# Install the local repository in editable mode to ensure local code usage
RUN /bin/bash -c "source /testbed/.venv/bin/activate && pip install -e ."

# Install Node.js dependencies if package.json exists in the root folder
RUN /bin/bash -c "cd /testbed && if [ -f package.json ]; then npm install; fi"

# Persist environment activation and Poetry path for interactive shells
RUN echo "source /testbed/.venv/bin/activate" >> /root/.bashrc && \
    echo "export PATH=/root/.local/bin:\$PATH" >> /root/.bashrc

# Ensure default shell is bash for all commands and interactive use
ENV SHELL=/bin/bash
